display_name: Eleutherius, disciple of Dionysius the Areopagite

names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Άγιοι Ρουστίκος και Ελευθέριος».
Read out of doxologia.ro’s life of Dionysius the Areopagite, «cu diaconul Elefterie».
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 760, «Елевферий Парижский, диакон, сщмч.», with the rank and office words left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους μαζί με τον Άγιο Διονύσιο, κατά τον επί Δομετιανού διωγμό (81 - 96 μ.Χ.)».

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 3 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Рустика пресвитера и Елевферия диакона (96).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the one icon the page sets over the whole day, «Совершается служба на шесть» — a service of six stichera.

attestations.note: Two readings of his rank, both kept: saint.gr makes him a martyr and a deacon, and days.pravoslavie.ru makes him «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, while agreeing that he was a deacon. The folder's types are still the Greek reading and the Russian one is recorded here. Its index of names also gives him a place the Greek does not, «Елевферий Парижский», Eleutherius of Paris.
doxologia.ro’s list for 3 octombrie names Dionysius the Areopagite alone, though its life of him tells of this martyr’s death with him (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 3 Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Ρουστίκος και Ελευθέριος»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs’s page for 3. октобар ст. ст. (civil 16 October) was not read (2026-09-17).
